topic: NSAID gastrointestinal and renal toxicity: COX-2 selectivity, PPI co-prescription, renal monitoring

source.title: Safe prescribing of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs in patients with osteoarthritis – an expert consensus addressing benefits as well as gastrointestinal and cardiovascular risks
source.whyItFits: Open expert consensus on safe NSAID prescribing that addresses COX-2 selectivity, upper-GI risk strategies including gastroprotection and PPI co-prescription, and names the kidney among NSAID adverse-reaction sites.

whyItFits: Open expert consensus on safe NSAID prescribing that addresses COX-2 selectivity, upper-GI risk strategies including gastroprotection and PPI co-prescription, and names the kidney among NSAID adverse-reaction sites.
coverageNote: Gastrointestinal risk reduction, COX-2 selection, and PPI co-prescription are explicit. Renal toxicity is named, but no monitoring interval is given, so none was invented.
rejectedInAppHints: In-app hits were off-target (for example a fruquintinib toxicity meta-analysis). The suggested Lanza ulcer-prevention guideline was not in PMC.
